title: Golden Sun
subtitle: A journey shaped by elemental power
summary: Golden Sun is Camelot's Game Boy Advance role-playing adventure following Isaac and his companions through the world of Weyard. Their elemental abilities, called Psynergy, are used both against enemies and to solve problems in the surrounding landscape. Towns, caves and ruins connect the journey's conversations with turn-based battles and environmental puzzles. The shared role of magic gives the adventure a clear identity: an ability learned for the party can also become the means of reaching another place, making character development useful beyond the next confrontation on the road.
body: Golden Sun is Camelot's Game Boy Advance role-playing adventure following Isaac and his companions through the world of Weyard. Their elemental abilities, called Psynergy, are used both against enemies and to solve problems in the surrounding landscape. Towns, caves and ruins connect the journey's conversations with turn-based battles and environmental puzzles. The shared role of magic gives the adventure a clear identity: an ability learned for the party can also become the means of reaching another place, making character development useful beyond the next confrontation on the road.

Psynergy allows characters to interact with objects and obstacles while exploring. A whirlwind can remove vegetation, while other abilities help move or transform something in the environment. Dungeons combine those powers with more conventional spatial tasks, such as pushing logs to make a crossing or changing the route of a mine cart. The player has to recognise which part of a scene is capable of responding. An elemental ability therefore becomes another way of reading the world, revealing practical connections between the party's powers and the objects placed along its route.

Elemental Djinn can be found and assigned to characters, changing their available abilities and development. Their use in battle also connects preparation with powerful summons, making the arrangement of the collection an important choice rather than a passive list of discoveries. The party's capabilities can shift as those spirits are redistributed. Golden Sun gives its journeys several linked forms of progress: another destination can reveal a new Djinni, that companion can change a character's options, and those options can help the group approach another battle or puzzle in a different way.
